info.name: BookSphere - Storytelling with Analytics Comparison BEFORE/AFTER
info.description:
BookSphere: Complete Storytelling with Analytics Comparison

This collection demonstrates the impact of data population on ALL analytics:

Test Structure
PHASE 0 - PROLOGUE
- Test of ALL 10 analytics in the initial state (BASELINE)

PHASE 1-5 - POPULATION
- 6 international users (US, GB, IT, FR, DE, ES)
- 12 strategic reviews on 4 different books
- 17 book likes + 6 author likes
- 15 follow relationships (dense social network)

PHASE 6 - EPILOGUE
- Test of ALL 10 analytics after population
- DIRECT COMPARISON with initial values
- Real impact demonstration

Tested Analytics (10 Total)
Public Analytics (8):
1. Trending Books
2. Book Rankings (filtered by year/author/genre)
3. Author Rankings
4. Revaluated Books (trend analysis)
5. Rankings by Book IDs
6. Internationality - Book
7. Internationality - Author
8. Influencers (genre-based)

Registered User Analytics (2):
9. Personalized Recommendations (Neo4j)
10. Yearly Wrapped (MongoDB aggregation)

The Characters
- Alice (US): Voracious novel reader
- Bob (GB): Literary critic, thriller lover
- Charlie (IT): Bibliophile, philosophical readings
- Dave (FR): Biography enthusiast
- Eve (DE): Classic lover
- Frank (ES): Discovers new authors

Database Impact
MongoDB: 12 Reviews, 4 Books stats updated, Month scores modified
Neo4j: 12 ReviewNodes, 11 LIKES (books), 15 FOLLOWS relationships
